strings.jp: るちあたち　心配だな
strings.en: I'm worried about Lucia and the others.

strings.jp:
＊のため
わたしも持って行ってやるか
strings.en:
Just in case,
I'll bring one along too.

strings.jp: 家に予＊のカサ　あったよな
strings.en: We had a spare umbrella at home, right?

strings.jp:
ずぶぬれで帰られても＊る
多少は急ぐか‥‥
strings.en:
It'd be a pain if they came home soaked.
Guess I'll hurry a little...

strings.jp: カサなら家に　なん本かあったな‥‥
strings.en: We had a few umbrellas at home...

strings.jp:
カサか‥‥
家にあったな‥‥
strings.en:
An umbrella, huh...
We had some at home...
